name: Nakatosa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakatosa town emblem in navy and green: a navy disc with green stylised leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Nakatosa, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Nakatosa town emblem — a navy disc with green stylised leaves
